## Scope

Problem, resulting behavior, explicit exclusions, and base branch/commit (identify any mission baseline).

## Affected domains

- [ ] Documentation / delivery infrastructure
- [ ] UI / app
- [ ] Coaching runtime / sporting policy / fixtures / tests / freeze / evidence
- [ ] Other (describe)

## Tests and evidence

Commands, results and exact commit/freeze; link applicable independent reviews. Explain skipped checks.

## Risks

Known limitations and affected consumers. CI passing does not grant domain or release readiness.

## Rollback

Revert commit(s) and any recovery steps; identify the last known good version.

## Coaching Core gates — complete when coaching paths or authority change

Otherwise write **N/A — no coaching impact**. This conditional checklist is reviewed by a person; it is not an automatic approval.

- [ ] Current Founder mission explicitly authorizes this scope; no implicit R7-B0/product activation.
- [ ] Exact base, candidate freeze, affected rules and preserved history identified.
- [ ] Node 24 locked install, full reference suite and applicable read-only freeze verifier pass.
- [ ] Existing frozen runtime/tests/policy/records remain intact, or an explicitly authorized successor mission has new evidence, preserved prior records and a reviewed CI adapter update.
- [ ] Required Engineering/Quality and SSCTR reviews cover these exact bytes when applicable; author is not the independent judge.
- [ ] Remaining scientific, clinical and pre-TestFlight gates are stated; no readiness inferred from CI.
